**Finding: deviation (MFN) — Section 7.2 (p0027)**

Section 7.2 imposed an open-ended MFN running against us: we would have had to extend to Silverline terms no less favourable than the best terms we give any other technology supplier — no defined product, no 12-month limit, no like-for-like carve-outs. That fails the fallback outright and sits in walk-away territory, and it directly contradicts Section 12.3 ("Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment"). No provision anywhere grants Customer MFN pricing, so there is nothing beneficial to preserve.

Redline (validated, preferred level): the smallest conforming edit turns the obligation into its negation, leaving numbering and surrounding fee terms untouched — "Customer **has no obligation to** offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the terms Customer offers any other technology supplier."
